newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen mixed in cautious trading.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen mixed in cautious trading.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are expected to be mixed on Tuesday with the market tone seen remaining cautious despite overnight rises on Wall Street, brokers said.

"I don't see any major happenings which could have strong impact on the market. The results announced today are not likely to have much impact as they are generally not very surprising," one broker said.
Sampoerna, Steady Safe, Bank Bali and Jakarta International Hotels announced rises in their 1996 net profits.
Brokers said bargain-hunting was expected in some big-capitalised stocks such as Telkom and Bimantara, but trading volume was likely to stay thin.
On Monday, the Jakarta composite index fell 0.79 points, or 0.12 percent, to close at 636.64 points.
